- **Percussion:** A shaker or a similar high-frequency percussion instrument adds to the rhythmic texture, playing a consistent, subtly intricate pattern on top of the main drum beat.

There are no vocals, speech, or noticeable sound effects. The clip seems to be a loop or a segment of a longer instrumental track, without a clear intro, verse, or chorus structure within this short duration. The production style is clean and polished with a modern feel.
